class.name: EditorExportPlatformPS2
class.brief_description: Exporter for PlayStation 2. Writes an EE ELF by spawning blazium-toolchain. No Godot export templates.
class.description: [EditorExportPlatformPS2] appears in Project → Export as "PS2" on Windows and Linux hosts only. Export runs [code]blazium-toolchain ps2 setup --profile compile[/code] (if needed) then [code]ps2 build --out[/code] using the guest stub bundled in the toolchain. Guest [code]*.cpp[/code] is written next to the ELF under [code]guest/[/code]. Optional Editor Setting [code]export/ps2/runtime_src[/code] replaces the stub ([code]--src[/code]). [code]export/ps2/runtime_overlay[/code], [code]BLAZIUM_PS2_OVERLAY[/code], or project [code]res://ps2_guest[/code] overlays extra or replacement sources ([code]--overlay[/code]). Preset [code]ps2/region[/code] is NTSC or PAL; [code]ps2/width[/code] is 640, 512, or 320 (heights 448/512 NTSC/PAL, or 224 at 320). Optional [code]ps2/make_iso[/code] then runs [code]ps2 iso[/code] (ISO9660, no [code].cue[/code]). One-click runs [code]blazium-toolchain ps2 run[/code] (PCSX2 [code]-elf[/code]) and fails if [code]PS2_BIOS_DIR[/code] is unset — export does not need BIOS. Scripts cook a custom IR (not the official GDScript or Luau VM). [code]play_xa[/code] is refused (no CD-XA). [code]play_fmv[/code] is a named no-op (no license-clean IPU decoder). GDExtension and C# are rejected. This class does not call [code]find_export_template()[/code] or [code]save_pack()[/code].
